commitments.detail: Seal the time capsule on the day of the family reunion.
Plan to open the time capsule exactly 20 years later, on the same date as the reunion.
Nora will ensure the time capsule is stored in a dry, cool place.
Each family member will contribute a signed letter and can include a personal item if they wish.
Choose a metal container to protect the contents.
Use acid-free sleeves to preserve the paper mementos and letters.
Include the grandmother's recipe card as a significant family item.
Collect three signed letters from family members.
Seal the capsule on the day of the reunion, August 20, 2023.
Open the capsule during a future family gathering on August 20, 2026.
Nora has the final say in all matters concerning the time capsule.
